item.text:
This pass corrected an important inference about F25’s execution impact.

The earlier `ExecedUpTo=-1` observation came from the audit harness, which does not run the background executor goroutine. Directly invoking the executor on the empty-command instance shows `executeCommand=true`, with the instance moved to `EXECUTED` and no client operation applied ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/diagnostic_fix5_seed6_debug_output.txt)). So the empty commit does not stall execution; it is silently treated as a successful no-op, dropping the recovered value without an explicit NOOP or detectable failure.

The F25 report section and impact statement now reflect that corrected consequence. The audit remains at **27 findings**, **42 failing finding tests**, and **5 passing controls**; the captured source is unchanged and builds cleanly.
